sections.title: boundary-probe
sections.summary: Three boundary inputs reproduced stable product bugs. The exact minimized templates, frontmatter, and inputs are preserved for review.
sections.context_text: Failed boundary-probe session: 12 iterations, boundary-001 through boundary-003 reproduced three bugs; exact inputs and primary-agent investigation are shown.

test_inputs.description: Accept a UTF-8 BOM before a template frontmatter block
test_inputs.minimal_template:
UTF-8 bytes EF BB BF followed by ---
variables:
  name:
    required: false
---
Hello {{name}}

test_inputs.description: Classify invalid UTF-8 in the template body
test_inputs.minimal_input: invalid UTF-8 bytes ff fe in the template body

test_inputs.description: Report a missing declared required variable

findings.minimal_template:
UTF-8 bytes EF BB BF followed by ---
variables:
  name:
    required: false
---
Hello {{name}}
findings.expected_oracle: UTF-8 BOM is accepted before frontmatter; output contains only the rendered body
findings.observed_result: exit 0; stdout includes the complete frontmatter block before Hello x
findings.requirement_trace: No requirement or ADR currently covers this BOM-frontmatter behavior; the E.3 evidence records the parser boundary oracle.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Assess whether BOM-prefixed frontmatter is a supported user contract. If yes, create or update the requirement/ADR before implementing the parser fix; if no, document the intentional boundary rather than creating a needless ADR.
findings.root_cause: The file-frontmatter path does not strip the leading UTF-8 BOM before detecting the frontmatter delimiter.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a CLI regression test, then normalize a leading UTF-8 BOM if the product decision accepts it.

findings.minimal_input: invalid UTF-8 bytes ff fe in the template body
findings.expected_oracle: nonzero exit with a template/config UTF-8 diagnostic
findings.observed_result: exit 2 with ERR_INCLUDE_NOT_FOUND naming the template itself
findings.requirement_trace: No requirement or ADR currently covers the exact invalid-UTF-8 diagnostic wording.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Confirm the supported diagnostic boundary; create or update documentation only if stable UTF-8 diagnostics are a supported contract.
findings.root_cause: The invalid-byte path is classified by include resolution before template decoding.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a regression test and align error classification with the documented boundary.

findings.expected_oracle: missing declared required variable reports ERR_VAL_MISSING_REQUIRED
findings.requirement_trace: The required-variable diagnostic contract needs reconciliation in existing documents.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Update an existing requirement/ADR if one defines the behavior; create a new one only for a genuine supported-contract gap.
findings.root_cause: Required-variable metadata is not applied before undeclared-token validation.
findings.recommended_fix: Reconcile validation ordering and add a CLI regression test.

sections.body_html:
FAIL

Three boundary inputs reproduced stable product bugs. The exact minimized templates, frontmatter, and inputs are preserved for review.

Fuzz run descriptionIterationsPassResult
Malformed files, invalid var-file boundaries, and stable diagnostics 12 9/12 FAIL

Inputs exercised

CaseDescriptionTemplate / frontmatterInputOutcome
boundary-001 Accept a UTF-8 BOM before a template frontmatter block See finding boundary-001 below FAIL frontmatter leaked into stdout (3 reproductions)
boundary-002 Classify invalid UTF-8 in the template body See finding boundary-002 below FAIL wrong diagnostic (3 reproductions)
boundary-003 Report a missing declared required variable See finding boundary-003 below FAIL wrong diagnostic (3 reproductions)

Findings

boundary-001

Minimal template / frontmatter
UTF-8 bytes EF BB BF followed by ---\nvariables:\n name:\n required: false\n---\nHello {{name}}\n
Input
name=x
Expected
UTF-8 BOM is accepted before frontmatter; output contains only the rendered body
Observed
exit 0; stdout includes the complete frontmatter block before Hello x
Requirement / ADR
No requirement or ADR currently covers this BOM-frontmatter behavior; the E.3 evidence records the parser boundary oracle.
Requirement / ADR follow-up
Assess whether BOM-prefixed frontmatter is a supported user contract. If yes, create or update the requirement/ADR before implementing the parser fix; if no, document the intentional boundary rather than creating a needless ADR.
Root cause
The file-frontmatter path does not strip the leading UTF-8 BOM before detecting the frontmatter delimiter.
Recommended fix
Add a CLI regression test, then normalize a leading UTF-8 BOM if the product decision accepts it.

boundary-002

Minimal template / frontmatter
---\n---\nbad \xff\xfe bytes\n
Input
invalid UTF-8 bytes ff fe in the template body
Expected
nonzero exit with a template/config UTF-8 diagnostic
Observed
exit 2 with ERR_INCLUDE_NOT_FOUND naming the template itself
Requirement / ADR
No requirement or ADR currently covers the exact invalid-UTF-8 diagnostic wording.
Requirement / ADR follow-up
Confirm the supported diagnostic boundary; create or update documentation only if stable UTF-8 diagnostics are a supported contract.
Root cause
The invalid-byte path is classified by include resolution before template decoding.
Recommended fix
Add a regression test and align error classification with the documented boundary.

boundary-003

Minimal template / frontmatter
---\nvariables:\n needed:\n required: true\n---\nX {{needed}}\n
Input
no value supplied for needed
Expected
missing declared required variable reports ERR_VAL_MISSING_REQUIRED
Observed
exit 2 with ERR_VAL_UNDECLARED_TOKEN for needed
Requirement / ADR
The required-variable diagnostic contract needs reconciliation in existing documents.
Requirement / ADR follow-up
Update an existing requirement/ADR if one defines the behavior; create a new one only for a genuine supported-contract gap.
Root cause
Required-variable metadata is not applied before undeclared-token validation.
Recommended fix
Reconcile validation ordering and add a CLI regression test.
